terms.gloss: an inheritance; the right of inheriting
evidence: Plaut. Curc. 127: mihi haud saepe ēvenunt tālēs hērēditātēs
Varr. RR 1.12.2: sī istīusmodī mī fundus hērēditāte obvēnerit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To come to someone by inheritance is hērēditāte venīre or obvenīre.

phrases.latin: mihi haud saepe ēvenunt tālēs hērēditātēs
phrases.english: legacies like this don’t often come my way
